patterns.name: Doji
patterns.description: Open and close are nearly equal, signaling indecision between buyers and sellers.
conditions: body is a very small fraction of the candle's full range
patterns.invalidation: next candle continues strongly in either direction with no follow-through pause

patterns.name: Dragonfly Doji
patterns.description: Doji with a long lower wick and virtually no upper wick, showing rejection of lower prices.
conditions: doji-sized body
lower wick dominates over upper wick
patterns.invalidation: close below the dragonfly's low
confluence_boost: after a liquidity sweep of a swing low

patterns.name: Gravestone Doji
patterns.description: Doji with a long upper wick and virtually no lower wick, showing rejection of higher prices.
conditions: doji-sized body
upper wick dominates over lower wick
patterns.invalidation: close above the gravestone's high
confluence_boost: after a liquidity sweep of a swing high

patterns.name: Hammer
patterns.description: Small body near the top of the range with a long lower wick, appearing after a downtrend.
conditions: lower wick at least ~1.8x the body
small upper wick
preceding short-term trend is DOWN
patterns.invalidation: close below the hammer's low
confluence_boost: after liquidity sweep of a swing low

patterns.name: Hanging Man
patterns.description: Identical geometry to the Hammer, but appears after an uptrend — a warning sign rather than a bullish signal.
conditions: lower wick at least ~1.8x the body
small upper wick
preceding short-term trend is UP
patterns.invalidation: close above the hanging man's high with continuation

patterns.name: Inverted Hammer
patterns.description: Small body near the bottom of the range with a long upper wick, appearing after a downtrend.
conditions: upper wick at least ~1.8x the body
small lower wick
preceding short-term trend is DOWN
patterns.invalidation: close below the inverted hammer's low
confluence_boost: followed by a bullish confirmation candle

patterns.name: Shooting Star
patterns.description: Identical geometry to the Inverted Hammer, but appears after an uptrend, signaling rejection of higher prices.
conditions: upper wick at least ~1.8x the body
small lower wick
preceding short-term trend is UP
patterns.invalidation: close above the shooting star's high
confluence_boost: after a liquidity sweep of a swing high

patterns.name: Bullish Marubozu
patterns.description: A bullish candle with almost no wicks — the body occupies nearly the entire range, showing one-sided control by buyers.
conditions: body ratio >= ~0.85 of full range
closes bullish
both wicks minimal
patterns.invalidation: the following candle closes back below the marubozu's open
confluence_boost: on a breakout with high volume
aligns with a higher-timeframe bullish bias

patterns.name: Bearish Marubozu
patterns.description: A bearish candle with almost no wicks — the body occupies nearly the entire range, showing one-sided control by sellers.
conditions: body ratio >= ~0.85 of full range
closes bearish
both wicks minimal
patterns.invalidation: the following candle closes back above the marubozu's open
confluence_boost: on a breakdown with high volume
aligns with a higher-timeframe bearish bias

patterns.name: Spinning Top
patterns.description: Small-to-moderate body with roughly balanced upper and lower wicks, showing hesitation rather than a strong directional signal alone.
conditions: body ratio roughly between 0.08 and 0.38 of range
upper and lower wicks of comparable size
patterns.invalidation: not a standalone signal; needs directional confirmation from the next candle
confluence_boost: after an extended move, as an early hesitation cue

patterns.name: Bullish Engulfing
patterns.description: A bullish candle whose body fully covers the prior bearish candle's body.
conditions: previous candle bearish
current candle bullish
current body fully engulfs previous body
patterns.invalidation: next candle closes below the engulfing candle's low

patterns.name: Bearish Engulfing
patterns.description: A bearish candle whose body fully covers the prior bullish candle's body.
conditions: previous candle bullish
current candle bearish
current body fully engulfs previous body
patterns.invalidation: next candle closes above the engulfing candle's high

patterns.name: Bullish Harami
patterns.description: A small bullish candle contained entirely within the prior, larger bearish candle's body — a slowdown in bearish momentum.
conditions: previous candle bearish with a large body
current candle bullish and contained within the previous body
patterns.invalidation: next candle makes a new low with continuation lower

patterns.name: Bearish Harami
patterns.description: A small bearish candle contained entirely within the prior, larger bullish candle's body — a slowdown in bullish momentum.
conditions: previous candle bullish with a large body
current candle bearish and contained within the previous body
patterns.invalidation: next candle makes a new high with continuation higher

patterns.name: Piercing Line
patterns.description: A bullish candle opens below the prior bearish candle's low then closes above the midpoint of its body.
conditions: previous candle bearish
current candle opens with a gap down then closes above the previous body's midpoint but below its open
patterns.invalidation: next candle closes below the piercing candle's low
confluence_boost: after a liquidity sweep of a swing low

patterns.name: Dark Cloud Cover
patterns.description: A bearish candle opens above the prior bullish candle's high then closes below the midpoint of its body.
conditions: previous candle bullish
current candle opens with a gap up then closes below the previous body's midpoint but above its open
patterns.invalidation: next candle closes above the dark cloud candle's high
confluence_boost: after a liquidity sweep of a swing high

patterns.name: Tweezer Top
patterns.description: Two consecutive candles with matching highs, the first bullish and the second bearish, showing repeated rejection at resistance.
conditions: two candles with highs within a small tolerance of each other
first candle bullish, second bearish
patterns.invalidation: next candle closes above the shared high
confluence_boost: aligns with a higher-timeframe supply zone

patterns.name: Tweezer Bottom
patterns.description: Two consecutive candles with matching lows, the first bearish and the second bullish, showing repeated rejection at support.
conditions: two candles with lows within a small tolerance of each other
first candle bearish, second bullish
patterns.invalidation: next candle closes below the shared low
confluence_boost: aligns with a higher-timeframe demand zone

patterns.name: Morning Star
patterns.description: A large bearish candle, followed by a small-bodied 'star' candle, followed by a large bullish candle closing well into the first candle's body.
conditions: first candle bearish with a large body
second candle has a small body (a pause)
third candle bullish and closes above the first candle's midpoint
patterns.invalidation: close back below the star candle's low

patterns.name: Evening Star
patterns.description: A large bullish candle, followed by a small-bodied 'star' candle, followed by a large bearish candle closing well into the first candle's body.
conditions: first candle bullish with a large body
second candle has a small body (a pause)
third candle bearish and closes below the first candle's midpoint
patterns.invalidation: close back above the star candle's high

patterns.name: Three White Soldiers
patterns.description: Three consecutive bullish candles, each closing higher than the last, with reasonably large bodies and small wicks.
conditions: three consecutive bullish candles
each closes above the previous close
each has a body ratio >= ~0.45
patterns.invalidation: a strong bearish reversal candle erasing most of the third candle's gain
confluence_boost: breaking out of a range with rising participation

patterns.name: Three Black Crows
patterns.description: Three consecutive bearish candles, each closing lower than the last, with reasonably large bodies and small wicks.
conditions: three consecutive bearish candles
each closes below the previous close
each has a body ratio >= ~0.45
patterns.invalidation: a strong bullish reversal candle erasing most of the third candle's decline
confluence_boost: breaking down from a range with rising participation

patterns.name: Three Inside Up
patterns.description: A Bullish Harami followed by a third candle that closes above the first candle's open, confirming the reversal.
conditions: first two candles form a Bullish Harami
third candle bullish and closes above the first candle's open
patterns.invalidation: close back below the harami's low

patterns.name: Three Inside Down
patterns.description: A Bearish Harami followed by a third candle that closes below the first candle's open, confirming the reversal.
conditions: first two candles form a Bearish Harami
third candle bearish and closes below the first candle's open
patterns.invalidation: close back above the harami's high
